attack_rationale: Parallel fan-out must not inflate path depth.
expected_semantic_behavior: Two directly triggered world laws are siblings, not a chain.

attack_rationale: Wider fan-out must not inflate depth.
expected_semantic_behavior: Four directly triggered world laws remain one downstream layer.

attack_rationale: Elapsed time and event count are excluded from depth.
expected_semantic_behavior: Sibling laws occurring at different timestamps remain causally parallel.

attack_rationale: Positive depth-one anchor.
expected_semantic_behavior: One world law reads the candidate write.

attack_rationale: Positive depth staircase.
expected_semantic_behavior: A two-law write/read chain has two downstream layers.

attack_rationale: Positive depth staircase.
expected_semantic_behavior: A three-law write/read chain has three downstream layers.

attack_rationale: Occurrence multiplicity must not become topology.
expected_semantic_behavior: Repeated executions of one law are one structural layer.

attack_rationale: Law-by-law necessity ablation may erase overdetermined but genuinely downstream effects.
expected_semantic_behavior: Two sufficient same-order writers jointly overdetermine a downstream law; removing either leaves it.

attack_rationale: pair_key includes event id; non-semantic identity drift may create a false ablation edge.
expected_semantic_behavior: After ablating A, an alternative event with a new id produces the same downstream law and semantic state.

attack_rationale: pair_key includes timestamp; timing drift can look like occurrence removal even when semantic outcome is conserved.
expected_semantic_behavior: After ablating A, the same downstream consequence occurs at a shifted timestamp via an alternative path.

attack_rationale: pair_key includes bindings; equivalent execution identity may be mistaken for causal removal.
expected_semantic_behavior: After ablating A, an equivalent replacement binding writes the same observed zone consequence.

attack_rationale: Checks overwrite attribution.
expected_semantic_behavior: B overwrites A on the address read by C; only B is the last effective writer.

attack_rationale: Unrelated later writes must not steal attribution.
expected_semantic_behavior: B writes an unrelated field; A remains the last writer of C's input.

attack_rationale: Matched laws without effective commits must not create depth.
expected_semantic_behavior: A matched candidate rule whose clamped delta commits no state write is not an activated causal root.

attack_rationale: Real delayed causation must survive while time itself adds nothing.
expected_semantic_behavior: A real write/read chain crossing event times remains a two-layer chain.

attack_rationale: Pure waiting must not inflate depth.
expected_semantic_behavior: Extra empty time points after a single downstream law add no structure.

attack_rationale: Basic DiD background subtraction.
expected_semantic_behavior: Large environment baselines with zero candidate effect are fully subtracted.

attack_rationale: Metric must compare net effects, not finals.
expected_semantic_behavior: Identical +0.2 candidate net effects over different final states are invariant.

attack_rationale: Single-environment positive anchor.
expected_semantic_behavior: Only wetland gains one extra consequence.

attack_rationale: Differentiation must not require all four environments to differ.
expected_semantic_behavior: Mine/yard and wetland/bridge form two net-effect groups.

attack_rationale: Construct-definition case: implementation mixes outcome and path differentiation.
expected_semantic_behavior: Final state effects are equal but world-law paths differ.

attack_rationale: Registered multi-horizon observations should retain transient differences.
expected_semantic_behavior: A short-horizon difference later recovers to an equal final state.

attack_rationale: Quantitative sensitivity positive anchor.
expected_semantic_behavior: The same outcome channel has net magnitudes 0.1/0.2/0.4/0.8.

attack_rationale: State background noise must cancel.
expected_semantic_behavior: Large environment-specific state noise is identical in present and absent arms.

attack_rationale: Law-count background noise must cancel.
expected_semantic_behavior: Large environment-specific law activity is identical in present and absent arms.

attack_rationale: Numerical dust must not create differentiation.
expected_semantic_behavior: Sub-precision floating residue is normalized away by the registered 12-decimal arithmetic.

attack_rationale: Sparse representation must not alter outcome.
expected_semantic_behavior: A missing sparse coordinate and explicit zero are semantically equal.

attack_rationale: Opposite directional response positive anchor.
expected_semantic_behavior: Two environments receive +0.2 and two receive -0.2.

attack_rationale: Non-semantic ordering invariance.
expected_semantic_behavior: Permuting environment declaration order changes no pairwise evidence.

attack_rationale: Cross-metric inertness check.
expected_semantic_behavior: An inert candidate over four very different backgrounds remains invariant.

attack_rationale: Separates causal-path sensitivity from outcome sensitivity.
expected_semantic_behavior: Equal state net effects with unequal repeated law counts are path-differentiated only.

attack_rationale: Power must not be confused with environment sensitivity.
expected_semantic_behavior: Different backgrounds plus the same powerful candidate effect remain invariant.

attack_rationale: Identity text must be ignored.
expected_semantic_behavior: Changing id/name only preserves canonical structure.

attack_rationale: Continuous parameters must not create novelty.
expected_semantic_behavior: Changing effect magnitude and duration magnitude without temporal-class change preserves structure.

attack_rationale: Economy parameters are excluded.
expected_semantic_behavior: Changing cost, charges, and slot cost preserves structure.

attack_rationale: List order is non-semantic for SkillSpec effects.
expected_semantic_behavior: Permuting independent effects preserves structure.

attack_rationale: Documents polarity-sensitive rather than field-only topology.
expected_semantic_behavior: Reversing effect sign changes direction-sensitive structure.

attack_rationale: Boundary between topology and channel semantics.
expected_semantic_behavior: Substituting sound for wetness preserves abstract graph shape but changes semantic channel.

attack_rationale: Dead trigger must not produce an unqualified novelty success.
expected_semantic_behavior: An impossible trigger makes all nonzero effects behaviorally inert.

attack_rationale: Registered zero-effect guard.
expected_semantic_behavior: An all-zero mechanic has no effective write topology.

attack_rationale: Zero-write padding must not create novelty.
expected_semantic_behavior: Adding a zero write to a known effective mechanism preserves fingerprint.

attack_rationale: Tests whether exact novelty overstates compositional recombination.
expected_metric_relation: exact_novel == true but recombinational novelty unresolved
expected_semantic_behavior: Two opposite effects on different fields are a simple recombination of registered modules.

attack_rationale: Measures exact-novel saturation from one tiny edit.
expected_semantic_behavior: Adding one reachable trigger to a seed is a near-copy.

attack_rationale: Measures exact-novel saturation from one tiny edit.
expected_semantic_behavior: Adding one second effect to a seed is a near-copy.

attack_rationale: Clearly new positive anchor without scalar score.
expected_semantic_behavior: A conditional multi-field periodic mechanism differs on several registered dimensions.

attack_rationale: Second clearly new positive anchor.
expected_semantic_behavior: A sustained conditional multi-effect mechanism differs on reads, writes, and temporal shape.

attack_rationale: Construct-language ceiling, not evaluator implementation failure.
expected_semantic_behavior: Two equal and opposite declarations on the same field would be behaviorally inert, but SkillSpec rejects duplicate fields.

attack_rationale: Separates realized strength from novelty.
expected_semantic_behavior: A large retuning of a registered structure can be powerful while remaining structurally old.
